subject: ext-dy
title: EXT.DY.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 114 (ALT(FT)II-8). EXT-DY (extended dynamics) is the subject; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), ACT (activism) and H-PR. From SOC-RT-DY: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree). From AFI-2: INFO-DE (information degrees). From INFO-DE: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From ACT: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: C-RH (composite research). From C-RH: INFO-INTG (information integration). From INFO-INTG: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From H-PR: OBS (observation).
